en: The postcard displays a black-and-white image of a historical European street lined with old buildings, featuring visible shop signs including 'Emil Ulrich.' The street is cobblestone in parts, with early 20th-century horse-drawn carriages and people walking. In the background, a church steeple with a clock is prominent. The text at the top reads: 'Sayda i. Erzgeb. Hauptstrasse.'
